articles.title: qcos-driver-sdk added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article introduces a comprehensive framework for operating Quantum Processing Units (QPUs). It details a system that integrates QPU calibration, predictive routing, quantum error correction (QEC), and error mitigation, alongside a canonical runtime API. This development aims to streamline the deployment and management of quantum computations, making advanced quantum technology more accessible, reliable, and standardized for users and developers.

articles.title: A First Nation Burned to the Ground Without Warning, Exposing Canada's Wildfire Response Failures
articles.summary: On July 13, 2026, a devastating wildfire rapidly overwhelmed Namaygoosisagagun First Nation (Collins First Nation) in northwestern Ontario, Canada. Striking with minimal warning, the fast-moving inferno led to the complete destruction of the community. This tragic incident highlights the severe impact of natural disasters on remote and vulnerable populations.
